title: Merge Intervals
intuition: Sort intervals by start times, then merge overlapping segments sequentially.
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize merged array with first interval.
Iterate through intervals; if current starts before previous ends, merge by updating end time.
Otherwise, append current interval as new segment.
complexity: Time: O(n log n) due to sorting, Space: O(1) or O(n)
content: Sort intervals by start times, then merge overlapping segments sequentially.
